messages:
Alex Chen: RFC draft for VPC/on-prem launch criteria posted. Focus: customer-managed egress (BGP/DNS), handshake + routing handshake, SLA matrix. Ping @Maria for acceptance criteria. Link: https://staging.docs/rfcs/vpc-handshake.md
Maria Gomez: Thanks — skimmed. Two immediate asks: (1) clear fallback model mapping when customer route fails, (2) explicit control-plane SLOs for handshake failures. Can we add simple pass/fail tests?
Kevin Patel: Agree. Also need an ops playbook snippet for route flap. Suggest acceptance criteria: a) passive health check within 3s, b) circuit fallback within 30s, c) customer alerts + auto-fallback.
Sophie Liu: For on-prem we need to clarify KMS handling and audit log paths. Is customer-managed KMS required or optional?
Alex Chen: Optional but recommended. Added note: default is Redwood-managed KMS; customer can opt-in. Will add audit event examples.
deploy-bot: Deploy preview: docs/rfcs/vpc-handshake.md (PR #482) — preview up at https://staging.docs/482
Maria Gomez: Acceptance criteria proposal (copy): 1) 99.9% control-plane handshake success over 24h baseline; 2) BGP session re-establish < 60s after flap; 3) Route priority respects customer preference config. Thoughts?
Kevin Patel: Concern: 99.9% maybe too tight for some on-prem networks; suggest offering two tiers: Standard (99.5) and Enterprise (99.9) with add-on SLA/monitoring. Also need to define test harness: simulated route flaps + p95 latency.
Sophie Liu: Edge case: asymmetric routing where customer egress AMI blocks inbound KV cache sync. Add acceptance test to validate KV sync path.
Alex Chen: Will update RFC with tiers + tests. For handshake example, adding snippet:
```yaml
handshake:
  type: bgp
  local_as: 65001
  remote_as: 65010
  routes: ['0.0.0.0/0']
  keepalive: 60
```
Oncall Ops: Ops note: add runbook step to force failover: `curl -X POST /v1/control/failover?target=customer-route` and verify fallback logs contain `route_fallback=success`.
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: Let's get a quick review pass by EOD. If accepted we'll move to spec and break into JIRA tickets.
